source_row.rationale: Facial burns, singed nasal hair, soot in the sputum, and hoarseness are classic warning signs of possible inhalation injury, warranting urgent airway assessment and close monitoring, since airway swelling from inhalation injury can progress rapidly, sometimes over just a few hours, potentially leading to complete airway obstruction if not anticipated and managed proactively (including early consideration of intubation in some cases).
source_row.source_detail: Warning Signs of Possible Inhalation Injury
